emergencyCallInstruction: Call 112 now if you believe there is an emergency or you are unsure.
doActions: Stay with the person if it is safe.
doNotActions: Do not delay the emergency call while waiting for this app.
Do not give food, drink, or unplanned medicine.
escalationRule: Tell 112 about any change in breathing, consciousness, bleeding, or safety.
